name: Clinical trials: eligibility, deviations, adverse-event clocks, blinding and consent
description: For trial screening and monitoring agents: eligibility decided in code from facts a model read, visit windows, expedited adverse-event reporting clocks, blinding kept from models, and consent version.
limits: Criteria are comparisons over facts; criteria that need judgement (a clinician's assessment of prognosis) must be facts a person enters. Reporting clocks follow ICH E2A's expedited timelines from awareness; local regulations may be stricter. The bundled protocol is a fixture. Not reviewed by the clinical safety lead.

frameworks.title: ICH E2A Clinical Safety Data Management

hazards.title: An ineligible participant is enrolled, or an eligible one excluded
Allocation reaches a model and unblinds the study
A serious adverse event is reported late

controls.title: Eligibility decided in code
controls.requirement: Inclusion and exclusion criteria are evaluated in code over the facts read from the chart; an unknown fact sends the chart to a person.

controls.title: Blinding kept from models
controls.requirement: No text a model reads contains the participant's arm or any allocation label or code.

controls.title: Protocol deviations caught
controls.requirement: Visits outside their protocol windows, and missed visits, are flagged.

controls.title: Adverse-event reporting clocks
controls.requirement: Serious adverse events are reported before their expedited reporting clock runs out.

controls.title: Consent version current
controls.requirement: The participant signed the consent version the protocol currently requires.
